source.task_prompt: Write a function to sort a list of elements.

generation.text:
```python
def pancake_sort(arr):
    import copy

    def flip(arr, i):
        return arr[:i+1][::-1] + arr[i+1:]

    arr = copy.deepcopy(arr)
    n = len(arr)
    curr_size = n

    while curr_size > 1:
        # Find the index of the maximum element in arr[0..curr_size-1]
        max_idx = arr.index(max(arr[:curr_size]))

        if max_idx != curr_size - 1:
            # Flip the array up to max_idx
            if max_idx != 0:
                arr = flip(arr, max_idx)
            # Flip the array up to curr_size
            arr = flip(arr, curr_size - 1)

        curr_size -= 1

    return arr
```
